name: Ulvenwald
description: The forest in Kessig where all roads lead to the Celestus.

pages_say.description: Innistrad's ancient forest bordering Kessig province and home to lycanthropes.
The forest where Klaus is hunted.
The forest in Kessig where all roads lead to the Celestus.
The forest from which the farmlands of Lambholt were carved.
